verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, the product can is shrunk and pushed into the top-right corner, and the badges are scattered with the tilted SUNSET SALE ribbon wedged between pills. The 'missing asset' placeholder box collides with the legal text at the bottom. The canvas is crammed with no breathing room and the headline overwhelms the product. A keeps the SOLSTICE logo readable with its sun mark sitting above it. B shrinks the logo to a tiny wordmark with the sun mark detached, which weakens the brand.
